blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —San Juan City, in cooperation with the Caring Keri Foundation, launched its Breast Cancer Awareness Month celebration on Oct. 5 at the Makabagong San Juan Theater inside the Makabagong San Juan National Government Center. The event, with the theme “Wellness and Wisdom: A Journey of Strength and Survivorship,” brought together 236 breast cancer patients and survivors for a day focused on health, wellness, and survivorship. The event featured various free health and wellness services, including: Mayor Francis Zamora shared the journey that he and his wife, Keri Zamora, went through following her breast cancer diagnosis in February 2019, including […]...
